tei:div.tei:p: (1na1)༄༅// dpal ldan dud sol lha mo'i gtor chog mdor bsdus bzhugs so//

"$ (1ba2)༄༅// gang zhig dran pa tsam gyis kyang*// bdud kyi g.yul las rgyal ba dang*// phun sum tshogs rnams yid bzhin du// ster mdzad dpal ldan lha mor 'dud// 'dir ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma dud pa'i sol ba zhes bya ba/ rgya bod thams cad na 'gran zla dang bral ba/ dkar phyogs skyong ba thams cad kyi gtso bo// rgyud sde gnyan po thams cad kyi bka' srung de nyid kyi gtor chog rgyas pa ni kho bos gzhan du bshad zin la// 'dir thun gter du bya ba'i rim pa rdo rje 'chang mar rngog yab sras kyi gsung ji lta ba bzhin 'god par bya ba ni/ rang nyid dgyes rdor gdan bzhi la sogs pa lha'i rnal 'byor sngon du 'gro bas mdun du skad cig gis dud sol ma'i snying kar pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa lte ba dang bcas pa/ de'i steng du aṃ 'od zer dang bcas pa/ de'i steng du raṃ 'od zer dang bcas pa/ raṃ las me 'bar bas dud sol gyi lus de dud par 'thul gyi bsregs pas thal bar gyur/ aṃ gi steng du baṃ de yongs su gyur pa las bum pa dkar po bdud rtsis gang ba las bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar po lhug lhug babs pas/ aṃ de 'od dkar lhag lhag gcig tu gyur/ oṃ aṃ mahā kā li de wi kā rā li bi kran+ta kā la rā tri tsaṇ+ḍa rū pi ni hūṃ phaṭa/ aṃ de yongs su gyur pa las dud pa'i sol ba ma sku mdog nag mo sprin dang bung ba ltar gnag pa shin tu sbeg pa keng rus kyi lus can zhal gcig phyag bzhi/ zhabs gnyis ma/ g.yas kyi dang po na ral gri me 'bar ba/ 'og man bhañja dmar gyis bskyil pa skra grol ba/ g.yon gyi dang po na shak+ti/ 'og ma na tri shu la dar dpyangs 'phyar ba thogs pa/ mi ro rengs pa khar bcug nas zhal mche ba zhig gcigs pa/ spyan gsum dmar po lhan ner ba lta ba/ dbu skra ral pa gyen du brdzes shing g.yon du 'khyil ba/ de la sbrul dang thod 'phreng gi brgyan pa/ rma bya'i rgyal mtshan gtsug na 'phyar ba/

snyan cha g.yas na sbrul gyi mgul nas dril bu gsil pa/ g.yon na seng ge ral pa dmar ba/ ro nye'i rna cha zung gis sgeg pa/ rna ltag gnyis nas me tog dang dar nag gi con pan 'phur ba/ lha ma yin la sogs pa'i thod pa'i do shal byas pa/ glang po che'i ko bas stod g.yogs pa/ ba glang gi ko rlon chen po dras pa la re lde ser po'i sham bu btags pas smad dkris pa/ khrag dang zhag gi thig les tshom bur bris pa/ (2na3)klu'i rgyal po gshibs pas ska rags byas pa/ zhabs gnyis lcags sgrog gis brgyan pa/ bong bu dmar ga'i steng na tsan skyil gyis bzhugs pa/ dur khrod brgyad du rgyu zhing hūṃ dang bh+yo'i sgra dung dang 'brug ltar sgrog pa/ ma mo mkha' 'gro dang sha za 'bum sde dbang du sdud pa'i skur gyur/ de'i thugs sgo nga'i dbyibs sor bzhi pa mar me lta bu/ 'od de'i dbus su hūṃ/ hūṃ de las 'od 'phrod tshur 'dus 'od kyi thig le'i nang du hūṃ gi mtha' skor du/ oṃ hūṃ shrī ya de wi kā li kā li mahā kā li hūṃ bh+yoḥzhes pas bskor bar gyur/ de'i thugs ka'i hūṃ las hūṃ gcig byung ste bha gar thim par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra lā s+ya ra ga yā mi hūṃ/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis nag po drag po drag po chen po'i dur khrod dang*/ byang puṣ+pa ha ri/ mar rngog gi gdan sa nas dud pa'i sol ba ma 'khor nag mo 'bum sde dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥrbod rnga dang rnge'u chung dril bu la sogs pa rol mo'i sgra dbyangs snyan pas/ hūṃ rang bzhin rnam dag ye shes sgyu ma'i klong*/ bde chen 'du 'bral med pa'i dkyil 'khor du// dus gsum ba'i 'phrin las gcig bsdus pa// dpal 'bar mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo dbyings nas bzhengs/ dur khrod myul zhing rnal 'byor las la 'brengs/ mi bzad rnam par 'phrul ba'i zhing khams dang*/ puṣ+pa ha ri mar rngog gdan sa dang*/

mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas nas 'dir gshegs shig /oṃ hūṃ shrī ya de wi kā li kā li hūṃ bh+yoḥdṛ ṣ+ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya hoḥye shes sems dpa'i gtso mo dam tshig pa la thim/ 'khor gcer bu ral pa can// g.yas na mi'i snying dmar po dmar rtser thogs pa/ g.yon na thod pa skra can khrag gis bkang ba 'khor 'du ma sde'i tshogs kyis bskor nas 'dug par gyur/ 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags stengs su bdud rtsi byin par mos pas gtor te/ dud pa'i sol ba ma khyod kyi sku myur du ston cig /sku mi ston na bdag gi yid la 'dod pa'i las thams cad myur du sgrubs shig /oṃ hūṃ shṝ ya sogs dang*/ e ā ra li hri nga dzaḥ'adi ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ster/ rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'di 'thung*/ oṃ badz+ra ha na ha na badz+ra sa ma ya ma ti kra ma la hūṃ phaṭa/ ces dam la (2ba4)bzhag /oṃ āḥhūṃ shrī ya de wi ya sogs dang*/ badz+ra puṣ+pe pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ de bzhin du dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yā/ shap+ta rnams kyis mchod// gtor mar bdud rtsi bran la/ gtor snod bhañja yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor rdzas rnams ha hoḥhriḥha ser pos gtor ma'i kha dog ngan pa bcom/ gtor ma kha dog phun sum tshogs pa gser zhun ma ltar gyur/ hoḥdakar pos dri ngan pa bcom nas dri phun sum tshogs par gyur/ hriḥsngon pos ro ngan pa bcom nas ro phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ ha ho hrīḥswāhā/ gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ gtor ma lag pas bteg la/ oṃ hūṃ shrī ya de wi sogs dang*/ oṃ mahā māṃ sa khā hi/ mahā tsit+ta khā hi/ mahā rak+ta khā hi/ mahā go ro tsa na khā hi/ mahā ba su ta khā hi/ oṃ i daṃ ba li gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭaḥswāhā/ gsum mam bdun gyis phul/

dud sol ma 'khor 'bum sde dang bcas pas gtor ma hab di ri ri gsol bar bsam/ rol mo dang bcas pas/ bh+yoḥtil mar gyis bskus lan bu gcig 'phyur ro nye'i rna chas sgeg cing rgyan rnams ma lus 'chang*/ zhes sogs gzungs nas phyungs pa'i bstod pas bstod/ oṃ ru ru ro ru tiṣ+ṭha pa dha si hūṃ bh+yo karma la rak+ṣa si hūṃ bh+yoḥdagra bgegs mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ gtor ma la bdud rtsis bran/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ lha mo gtso 'khor gyi thugs kar phog /thugs rgyud bskul sdom dam bcas pa dran nas thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ gdug pa thams cad tshar bcad/ dregs pa thams cad kyi nus mthu bsdus lha mo'i thugs kar thim// de nas 'od zer gyi rnam par zhal nas 'thon nas bdag nyid kyi thugs kar thim pas/ nus mthu phun sum tshogs par gyur par bsams te/ oṃ hūṃ shrī ya de wi kā li sogs brgya 'am nyer gcig las mi nyung bar bzlas so// slar yang gtor ma la chang phud bran la/ oṃ kuru ku ru war+t+ta li mahā bar+t+ta li bh+yoḥbh+yoḥdur khrod bdag mo dngos grub zhal/ gtum mo gcigs byed yi dgas gdong*/ dam tshig bsrung ma khrag dga' ma/ ki li'i sgra sgrog sbyor zin ma/ dur khrod ro yi tshal dbus na// gtum chen dud pa'i sil ba mo// tshogs dang pho nyar bcas pa yi// rtse gcig (3na5)lha mo dud sol ma// gsol zhing bzhes shig dam tshig lha// gnas nas gnas par mdzad du gsol// bdag gi sems la ci 'dod pa'i// las 'di myur du grub par mdzod// bdag gi las 'di ci byed kyang*// bde legs kun gyi grogs mdzod cig /zo zhig 'thung zhing tshim pa yis// rang gi gnas la gnas kyi hūṃ// gdug pa can rnams thams cad bzung*// za zhing 'thung la longs spyod cig /phu pheṃ pheṃ phiṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa dang*/ 'phrin las bcol ba ni/ mkha' 'gro ma dud sol ma 'khor 'bum sde dang bcas pa khyod kyis/

mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma kha dog dam pa dri dam pa/ ro dam pa/ reg bya dam pa dang ldan pa 'di bzhes la rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad kyi rigs su gyur pa/ rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa las gyur pa'i nad rigs thams cad zhi zhing bzlog par mdzad du gsol/ gdon gyi rigs su gyur pa lha dang*/ klu dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ rgyal po'i gnod pa la sogs pa thams cad zhi zhing bzlog par mdzad du gsol/ rmi lam ngan pa dang*/ mtshan ma ngan pa la sogs pa spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bzlog cing zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ gzhan yang rnal 'byor pa bdag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi grogs gyis/ mthu gyis/ dpung gyis/ sdun nas bsus/ phyi nas skyol// bsam pa sgrubs// re bskongs// ji ltar 'dod pa'i don thams cad phyin pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig /ces gsol bas de ltar bgyi'o zhes khas blangs par gyur par bsam/ shrī man de wi dhū maṃ ga ri sa pa ri wā re a r+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta pra tits+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ sngon tshe dpag bsam byang chub shing drung du/ rgyal ba thub pa chen po'i spyan snga ru/ bstan pa gnyan po bsrung bar dam bcas pa'i// khrag 'thung dud sol sku la phyag 'tshal lo// ces bstod ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang*/ gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyid pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun lha mos bzod par gsol// badz+ra lā s+ya/ rā ga yā mi hūṃ/ dam tshig pa dang ye shes kyi lha mo dbyer med pa 'khor bcas sku gzugs sam/ rang gi snying kar bsdu/ sems can thams cad (3ba6)nad med cing*// sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /gang gi lam nas grol ba yi// sangs rgyas nyid dang phrad par shog /ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang*// ma grol ba rnams grol ba dang*// da lta nyid du rjes stsol ba'i// lam de nyid la gnas par shog

/bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis// 'jig rten 'dir ni myur du sangs rgyas shog /'gro la phan phyir chos rnams ston byed cing*// sems can sdug bsngal tshogs kyis bzir las sgrol// zab mo rgyud kyi srung ma ma mo ni// zhal gcig phyag bzhi 'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub// rdzu 'phrul mthu ldan dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i// dpal ldan dud sol lha mo'i bkra shis shog /ces shis pa brjod par bya'o// de ltar mar rngog gi gsung lhad ma zhugs pa 'di// sa gsum na 'gran zla med pa'i mi'i dbang po gong ma chen po ngag gi dbang phyug bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i thugs dam du shākya'i dge slong mi pham pad+ma dkar pos sbyar bas dpal ldan phag mo grub pa'i bstan pa phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig /shu bha ma stu sarba dza ga taṃ/// /maṅga laṃ/ chos sbyin rgya cher spel ba'i ched// par bzhengs glegs bu re re la// dngul krang yon 'gyed mdzad po ni// chos rgyal bsod nams rgyal mtshan no/// /
